{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A single '''city''' was present on [[Quockra-4]] and was located near its [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. It was built largely underground to escape the extreme temperatures of Quockra-4. 

The city was entirely inhabited by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of a thousand different varieties, where [[Yellow repair droid|yellow repair droids]] were superior to other models and gave out orders in their machine language; [[Red worker droid|red worker models]] were in the middle; [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] droids and other off-world models were at the bottom, functioning as translators for those of higher rank when speaking with [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. <ref name="GG">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>
